compiled_state.title: Write RED unit tests for pr-comment-lib.sh (mcp-probe, reply-posting, chain-walk)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD7: unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic (test-first, RED phase)

## Test Approach
- Given: shell functions sourced from pr-comment-lib.sh with a mock gh stub in PATH and mock MCP env
- When: each function is called with controlled inputs
- Then: assert expected outputs/exit codes and that no real API calls escape

## Implementation Notes
Write tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-lib.sh covering three behaviors:
1. probe_mcp_server: exits 0 when mock MCP tool responds; exits non-zero when tool-not-found/timeout
2. post_thread_reply: routes to inline endpoint (POST /pulls/{n}/comments/{id}/replies) for is_inline=true;
   routes to issues endpoint (POST /issues/{n}/comments) for is_inline=false
3. resolve_root_comment_id: returns the comment itself when in_reply_to_id is null; walks chain to root for replies;
   terminates at max-depth (50) when cycle is detected

The script under test does NOT exist yet, so all tests must fail at RED.
After writing the tests, add a RED marker in .test-index:
  plugins/dso/scripts/lib/pr-comment-lib.sh:tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-lib.sh [test_probe_mcp_exits_0_on_success]

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-lib.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-lib.sh
- [ ] Test file contains at least 3 test functions covering probe_mcp_server, post_thread_reply, resolve_root_comment_id
  Verify: grep -c "^test_" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-lib.sh | awk '{exit ($1 < 3)}'
- [ ] All tests in test-pr-comment-lib.sh fail (RED) because the source file does not exist yet
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-lib.sh; [ $? -ne 0 ]
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_probe_mcp_exits_0_on_success] for pr-comment-lib.sh
  Verify: grep '\[test_probe_mcp_exits_0_on_success\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] No real GitHub API calls or MCP calls escape (mock gh stub validates URL patterns)
  Verify: grep -q "GH_CALL_LOG\|stub" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-lib.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
